B1_residual_variance_shares.note: room share is near zero by construction (the shift is fitted per room); person share is the unobserved person component that selection would carry

B1_room_pair_predicts_within_person_diff.reading: treatment: the room pair predicts how the same person's residual differs between rooms (r2 above the null); selection: it does not (r2 at the null), because a person level unobserved cancels within the person

B4_tail_predicts_membership.reading: a person's residual on the tail in one room predicting the tail coordinate of their OTHER rooms is homophily on the tail: the tail carries who a room selects. The plane row is the comparison on the dominant axes.
